notes.title: Exile Princes: News & What Next
notes.notes:
Hi all, just a post to update people on what's next. As I said when tEP was releasing, where the game went next would depend in large part on the community and feedback available. In general, that's been at quite low levels, so I'm largely focus-shifting to the next game project. I can't confirm details of that yet, still very much in prototyping phase, but I'm excited about the possibilities I'm looking at and - albeit in [i]very[/i] different ways to the Exile Princes - starting to build another interesting and unusual take on a medieval fantasy world for people to explore.

However, I don't want to leave people here in the lurch - there will be more updates coming for this game as well. I had been looking at rushing patch 2 out in late January or early February, but right now it's only got one minor late-game bugfix compared to patch 1, so that may come out soon as a hotfix leaving the actual patch 2 for some feature tweaks people have requested. In particular I'm looking at whether there's a neater way to do sound settings, as a couple of people have found the hotkey system for that tricky, and whether I can put an accessibility contrast override of some kind on the text readouts for people who need that. I'm looking at sitting down and having a better crack at those changes, and possibly making some content additions, in late February or early March. I'm not sure what content people most want more of in the game, so if you're playing and have an opinion on that, please let me know.

Thanks to all of you who've played this weird little game, especially the fifty or so of you who've put upwards of three hours of your lives into exploring the Exile Realms - I'm glad you found something that spoke to you in this world I built. Until next time!

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.notes:
This first patch is mostly bugfixes.

Changelog:

[list]
[*]     Fixed bug where if you quit a game while injured then started a new game, your new character could inherit the bleedout effect.
[*]     Fixed bug where kind characters' objections to leaving woodcutters to their fate would cause an error.
[*]     Spelling error when petting a dog or kinklade now fixed.
[*]     Fixed rare bug where cities with names of under five characters would fail to have elections resolved properly or change rulers after sieges (causing game freezes at the end of siege battles) because the game was searching for an index in the city name rather than the city data.
[*]     Fixed bug where characters with underscores in their names wouldn't load saves properly by banning underscores from character names in future.
[*]     Fixed bugs where pets and dragons could get involved in normal campfire conversations and NPC romances.
[*]     Fixed bug where the info readout for a city army's unit showed you results for the equivalently numbered unit in your own army.
[/list]

As ever, please do report bugs on the steam forum, or the official forum.

notes.title: The Exile Princes is available for download!
notes.notes:
After about six years of development cycle, the game is finally available to play! I'm excited to be able to share this strange, quirky little medieval world and all the colourful people that live in it with all of you and I hope that you manage to not only become masters of the Exile Realms but also to slay monsters, find love, sail the seas, explore the deep woods, and find your questing selves along the way.

As with any game launch, there's suddenly going to be a lot more people playing this than ever did QA for it, so whilst I've done my best to make the experience bug-free, some of you are statistically likely to do something I never thought of and hit a consequent problem. If you encounter bugs, please report them, ideally on the [url=https://exilian.co.uk/forum/index.php?board=243.0]official forum[/url].

As for what's next, that depends on you guys. Sales figures aren't really a thing for a game that's free, but I'll judge how much it's worth adding to the game in part by the interest and activity it generated. If you want more, ask for it! I consider the game complete as is, but I'm expecting to do at minimum one minor content patch as well as patches for bugfixing and possibly balance (things like the ironman mode may get a difficulty hike if too many people are completing it too easily!) There's a lot more that's possible - I have notes for at least two much large major updates which would add factions, endgame scenarios, etc - but I'll get to those only if people are interested enough in the game for it to be worth working on them over & above other projects like finishing a novel and starting on the next game. The fate of the Exile Realms, in more ways than one, is in your hands.

I'd finally like to take the chance to thank everyone who volunteered to test this, and everyone who contributed directly - especially Seth Miller whose additional instrumental pieces have given the soundtrack a fantastic tune-up in the late stages of development, and especially the Exilian web community to whom this game is collectively dedicated. And I'd like to thank in advance all of you who play and provide feedback on this, I'm keen to learn what you have to say about the game.
